5.3.1 Definition
Definition: Let X be an n × p random matrix (→ I/1.2.4) and let Y be a p × p positive-definite
symmetric matrix. Then, X and Y are said to follow a normal-Wishart distribution
X, Y ∼ NW(M, U, V, ν) , (1)
if the distribution of X conditional on Y is a matrix-normal distribution (→ II/5.1.1) with mean M,
covariance across rows U, covariance across columns Y
−1 and Y follows a Wishart distribution (→
II/5.2.1) with scale matrix V and degrees of freedom ν:

)
Y ∼ W(V, ν) .
